headline: 1998 executive order updated the Manual for Courts-Martial, the rulebook for military criminal trials.
what_it_does: This order made changes to the Manual for Courts-Martial, which sets the procedures, rules of evidence, and punishments used in US military criminal trials. No summary was provided, so the specific changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the US armed forces
who_it_affects.how: Service members charged with crimes under military law face trials run under the updated rules.

who_it_affects.group: Military judges, prosecutors, and defense lawyers
who_it_affects.how: They must follow the amended procedures and evidence rules in courts-martial.
